name: canon
description: Read your team's shared knowledge vault from Claude Desktop and Cowork. Read-only: it returns notes, Claude reasons.
long_description:
canon turns a folder of markdown notes into shared context every agent on your team can read. This bundle exposes that vault to Claude Desktop and to local Cowork sessions over MCP.

Four tools, all read-only, and no write tool at all: canon_router returns the vault's map, canon_search greps it, canon_list browses folders, canon_read returns a note. Every caller-supplied path is resolved through a symlink-aware check that refuses anything outside the vault you selected.

Pick your vault folder during install. If your team already shares a vault repository, clone it first and point this at the clone.

vault_dir.title: Knowledge vault folder
vault_dir.description: The folder holding your team's notes. If the vault is a shared git repository, clone it first and choose the clone.

router.title: Router note
router.description: The note that maps what lives where. Leave as-is unless your team renamed it.

exclude.title: Folders to skip
exclude.description: Comma-separated paths the tools will not read — useful for large vendored doc trees that would swamp search results.
